description: This file implements eviction policies for a disk cache, including an in-development enhanced eviction policy with reuse tracking and list management, as well as functions for trimming cache entries and managing cache entry rankings.

classes.name: Eviction
classes.description: Manages cache eviction policies, including simple and enhanced algorithms, cache trimming, and entry ranking updates.

methods.name: Eviction::Init
methods.description: Initializes the eviction object with backend data, setting parameters and state.

methods.name: Eviction::Stop
methods.description: Stops eviction processing and invalidates weak pointers.

methods.name: Eviction::TrimCache
methods.description: Performs cache trimming based on current size and policies, either synchronously or via delayed tasks.

methods.name: Eviction::UpdateRank
methods.description: Updates the ranking of a cache entry, either using the simple or new eviction policy.

methods.name: Eviction::OnOpenEntry
methods.description: Handles logic when a cache entry is opened, updating its reuse count and rankings if new eviction policy is enabled.

methods.name: Eviction::OnCreateEntry
methods.description: Handles logic when a cache entry is created, inserting it into rankings.

methods.name: Eviction::OnDoomEntry
methods.description: Handles logic when a cache entry is doomed, removing it from rankings.

methods.name: Eviction::OnDestroyEntry
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a cache entry is destroyed.

methods.name: Eviction::SetTestMode
methods.description: Enables test mode for eviction, altering behavior for testing purposes.
